verses.gurmukhi: ਗੰਗ ਬਨਾਰਸ ਹਿੰਦੂਆ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣਾਂ ਮਕਾ ਕਾਬਾ।
verses.translit_en: ga(n)g banaaras hi(n)dhooaa musalamaanaa(n) makaa kaabaa|

en.bdb: Hindus adore Ganges and Banaras and Muslims consider Mecca-Kaba as a holy place.

verses.gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਬਾਬਾ ਗਾਵੀਐ ਵਜਨਿ ਤਾਲ ਮ੍ਰਿਦੰਗੁ ਰਬਾਬਾ।
verses.translit_en: ghar ghar baabaa gaaveeaai vajan taal miradha(n)g rabaabaa|

en.bdb: But to the accompaniment of mridang (drum) and rabaab (stringed instrument) the praises (of Baba Nanak) are sung.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਆਇਆ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਅਜਬੁ ਅਜਾਬਾ।
verses.translit_en: bhagat vachhal hoi aaiaa patit udhaaran ajab ajaabaa|

en.bdb: Lover of the devotees, He has come to uplift the down trodden ones. He Himself is wonderful (because in spite of His powers He is egoless).

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਇਕ ਵਰਨ ਹੋਇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹੋਇ ਤਰਾਬਾ।
verses.translit_en: chaar varan ik varan hoi saadhasa(n)gat mil hoi taraabaa|

en.bdb: By His efforts, all the four varans have become one and now the individual gets liberated in the holy congregation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨੁ ਵਾਸੁ ਵਣਾਸਪਤਿ ਅਵਲਿ ਦੋਮ ਨ ਸੇਮ ਖਰਾਬਾ।
verses.translit_en: cha(n)dhan vaas vanaasapat aval dhom na sem kharaabaa|

en.bdb: Like the fragrance of sandalwood, He, without any discrimination, makes every one fragrant.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਿਸ ਦੀ ਕਰੈ ਜਵਾਬਾ।
verses.translit_en: hukamai a(n)dhar sabh ko kudharat kis dhee karai javaabaa|

en.bdb: All act as ordained by Him and no one has the power to say no to Him.
Such grand Guru (Nanak) is the manifest spiritual teacher of the whole world.
